quran.note: Elisha is named with Ismail, Yunus and Lut, all preferred over the worlds.
Elisha is named with Ismail and Dhul-Kifl among the outstanding.

scholarly.work: Ma’ariful Qur’an (English edition, read on Quran.com)
scholarly.author: Mufti Muhammad Shafi’
scholarly.summary: Reports from Mujahid, through Ibn Jarir, that Dhul-Kifl was a deputy of Yasa’. The author concludes he was Yasa’s deputy. This is the only link to Alyasa in the work.
